answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a verifiable work history and a refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior. Creating one trusted identity is cheap, but spinning up thousands costs real capital and time, like trying to fill a canyon with water carried one bucket at a time. New identities start with narrow rate limits and earn wider access only after sustained honest work, so an attacker faces a glacier-slow climb while the ocean of legitimate traffic keeps flowing. Sybil accounts that behave badly lose their stake and reputation, making mass fakery unprofitable.
